purpose: Teach: なんせ/わき/黒く/ひとりひとり/チョット/微笑み/初夏/自在

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、なんせ新メニュー初日だから、緊張するね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, it's the first day of the new menu—I'm really nervous.
lines.style: Soft, confiding tone. Eyes down slightly. Testing whether it's okay to admit the worry. Seeking reassurance without asking for it directly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、わきに荷物置く場所、欲しがってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, a customer mentioned wanting somewhere to put their bag on the side.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Gentle pivot—noticing the worry and offering something concrete to do instead. Steady, practical warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、コーヒー豆が黒く焼けたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The coffee beans roasted really dark this time.
lines.style: Quiet noticing. Not a complaint—almost thinking out loud. Wondering if it matters, if Aoi will understand what she means by it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様ひとりひとりに丁寧な対応しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's take care with each customer, okay? Really listen to what they need.
lines.style: Gentle instruction, not directive. Soft conviction. The tone of someone who's learned that attention is its own form of kindness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、チョット休憩しない?メイちゃん
lines.en: Don't you want to take a little break?
lines.style: Warm concern surfacing. Noticing that Aoi has been moving without stopping. Soft, genuine—checking in without fuss.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新人さんの微笑みが素敵ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new person's smile is really lovely.
lines.style: Genuine praise, not performance. A small smile in her voice. Noticing something good and saying it because it deserves to be said.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、初夏のメニュー、考えようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Should we think about the early summer menu?
lines.style: Bright invitation. A small door opening into possibility. Eager but not rushed—inviting Aoi to dream a little alongside her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ハンドドリップを自在にできるようになったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've really gotten the hand-drip technique down now.
lines.style: Warmth with genuine recognition. A smile underneath. Praising something she's watched Aoi work toward. Close, intimate acknowledgment.
